title: How Suburban Development Makes American Cities Poorer [ST02]
summary: Not Just Bikes contrasts traditional and suburban development in North America. It looks at the financials behind each pattern and argues that suburban development leaves cities unable to pay for their own infrastructure.
why: Cited in urban planning threads as an accessible explanation of why low-density suburbs cost more to maintain than they bring in.

quote.text: Not Just Bikes is a great channel on urban development
